Done. Set up the project using the [`to-regex-range`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/to-regex-range) package.

- `package.json` — project metadata + dependency
- `index.js` — `rangeToRegex('1-100')` parses the range and returns a `RegExp`; CLI usage: `npm start -- 1-100`
- `.gitignore` — ignores `node_modules/`

`node index.js 1-100` outputs `^((?:[1-9]|[1-9][0-9]|100))$`, matching 1–100.
